edit.title: Edit post
edit.imageHint: Pick one of your product photos or upload your own. Instagram takes JPEG photos.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.boardsFailed: Couldn't load your Pinterest boards. Reconnect Pinterest and try again.
schedule.past: Pick a time at least {{count}} minutes from now.
schedule.notLinkedBody: Connect your social accounts to unlock direct scheduled publishing.
schedule.needImages_one: This post needs a photo. Tap to add one.
schedule.needImages_other: This post needs at least {{count}} photos. Tap to add them.
schedule.tooManyImages_one: This channel takes one photo. Tap to choose it.
schedule.tooManyImages_other: This channel takes at most {{count}} photos. Tap to choose them.

schedule.expired: {{channel}} needs you to sign in again

brief.title: Create a post
brief.subtitle: Choose a product and creative direction
brief.directionPlaceholder: e.g. Focus on hand-crafted joinery and warmth
brief.noProducts: No product photos yet. Add some so the writer has something to show.

stories.title: Stories
stories.subtitle: 9:16 vertical social moments
stories.newStoryBody: Pick a product and a goal. The agent writes a 3 to 5 frame story you can edit.
stories.noProducts: Add products with a photo to your catalog first.
stories.directionPlaceholder: e.g. Show it in a cosy living room
stories.loadFailed: Couldn’t load your stories. Check your connection.
stories.emptyBody: Start one from a product. The agent writes it, you check and approve it.
stories.deleteBody: The draft and its frames are removed. This can’t be undone.
stories.markDoneBody: The story is marked as posted with the frames that went out. You can’t post the rest afterwards.

errors.credits: Not enough credits to write a story.
errors.limit: Too many posts written today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.requestUsed: This request was already used. Close this and start a new story.
errors.notDeletable: Only draft stories can be deleted.
errors.expiredConfirm: The frames already posted have expired. Posting the rest makes a story of {{remainingFrames}} frames. Tap again to go ahead.
errors.alreadyHandled: This was already handled. Open Stories again to see where it stands.
errors.partlyPosted: Part of this story is already posted. Post the rest or mark it as done.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Try again later.
errors.stale: Someone else changed this story. Your changes weren’t saved.
errors.notEditable: This story can’t be edited any more.
errors.renderLimit: Too many story saves this hour. Try again later.
errors.type: Photos can be JPG or PNG, clips MP4 or MOV.
errors.tooLarge: That file is too large (photos up to 15 MB, clips up to 100 MB).
errors.uploadLimit: Too many uploads this hour. Try again later.
errors.videoLong: Clips can be up to 3 minutes.

editor.label: Label
editor.headline: Headline
editor.tooLong: {{field}}: too long for the frame. Shorten it.
editor.frameTooLong: Frame {{n}}’s text doesn’t fit. Shorten it.
editor.badLink: Use a link that starts with https://
editor.noDraft: The writer hasn’t drafted this story yet.
editor.discardBody: Your edits to this story aren’t saved.

detail.title: Story
detail.loadFailed: Couldn’t load this story. Check your connection.
detail.noFrames: No frames yet. Edit the story to add photos.
detail.renderFailedBody: Open the story and save it again.
detail.noPublish: Someone who can publish has to schedule it or post it by hand.

byHandView.title: Post it by hand
byHandView.saved: Frames saved to your gallery in order, in the album “{{album}}”.
byHandView.shared: The frames were sent one at a time. Keep them in order when you add them.
byHandView.downloadStopped: The download stopped at frame {{n}} of {{total}}. Nothing was saved. Try again.
byHandView.noGallery: This phone can’t save or share the frames.
byHandView.step1: Save the frames to your phone.
byHandView.step2: Open Instagram, tap + and choose Story.
byHandView.step3_other: Add frames 1 to {{count}} in order, as one story.
byHandView.step4: Add a Link sticker and paste the link.
byHandView.step5: Post it, then come back and tap “I posted it”.
byHandView.saveFailed: The frames couldn’t be saved to your gallery. Try again.

scheduling.scheduleBody: Posts by itself from your Instagram business account.
scheduling.noLinkScheduled: No tappable link when scheduled: Instagram only lets you add the link sticker by hand.
scheduling.byHandBody: At the time you pick, the story shows as due. You save its frames and post them from Instagram.

crop.hint: Drag or pinch the picture to frame it.
crop.locked: Frames from a reel keep their framing.

trim.window: Part of the clip that plays

picker.rightsQuestion: Do you own this photo or clip, or have permission to use it?
picker.rightsYes: We own or may use this
picker.rightsRefused: We can only use photos and clips you own or have permission to use.
picker.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to take a photo or video.
picker.noProducts: No product photos for this story.

picker.generateMissing: We couldn’t find that photo or clip. Pick it from the Library tab.

planner.title: Posts planner
planner.cadenceHint: What's planned so far. Generate fills the next 30 days around it.
planner.reviewNote: Manual review before publishing: Generated drops are placed in your calendar as drafts for your final confirmation. No content is published without approval.
planner.noPillars: No posts planned for this month yet.
planner.started: Planning your next 30 days. The first drafts appear on the calendar in a few minutes, ready for you to approve; the rest follow as they're written.
planner.done_one: Planned {{count}} post. Its draft appears on the calendar once it's written, ready for you to approve.
planner.done_other: Planned {{count}} posts. Drafts appear on the calendar as they're written, ready for you to approve.
planner.unscheduled_one: {{count}} had no free slot in the next 30 days.
planner.unscheduled_other: {{count}} had no free slot in the next 30 days.
planner.nothingToDo: No new ideas to plan yet. Fresh ideas arrive each morning.
